description: This Java class 'ShippingEstimateWrapper' calculates and manages shipping estimates, shipping methods, and shipping time estimates for shopping cart items within an order processing system. It interacts with various OFBiz components to retrieve shipping options and estimates based on cart data.

classes.name: ShippingEstimateWrapper
classes.description: A class that encapsulates shipping estimation logic for shopping cart items, including methods to load shipping options, estimates, and time estimates, and to retrieve these details.

methods.name: getWrapper
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new ShippingEstimateWrapper instance for a specific shopping cart and shipping group.

methods.name: ShippingEstimateWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the wrapper with cart data, loads shipping methods, estimates, and shipment time estimates.

methods.name: loadShippingMethods
methods.description: Loads available shipping methods for the current cart and shipping address.

methods.name: loadEstimates
methods.description: Calculates shipping estimates for each available shipping method based on cart data and allowances.

methods.name: loadShipmentTimeEstimates
methods.description: Loads estimated shipment times for each shipping method.

methods.name: getShippingMethods
methods.description: Returns the list of available shipping methods.

methods.name: getAllEstimates
methods.description: Returns a map of all shipping estimates.

methods.name: getShippingEstimate
methods.description: Returns the shipping estimate for a specific shipping method.

methods.name: getShippingTimeEstimates
methods.description: Returns the list of shipping time estimates.

methods.name: getShippingTimeEstimateInDay
methods.description: Returns the estimated shipping time in days for a specific shipping method.
